name: Ryoujoku Tonari no Onee-san
source:
Main character is a university student who lives alone. In the room next to him there lives an office lady from a trade company. One day protagonist abducts her on the way home from work to release her worries, but he can not restrain the whirlpool of desires awakened.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名獨居的大學生，隔壁住著一位在貿易公司任職的職業女性。一天，為了排解心中的煩悶，他在她下班回家的路上將她綁走。然而，一經喚醒的慾望便化作漩渦，令他再也無法剋制自己……

[內容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
